svg.title: Keep a ticket and its updates in one session
svg.desc: A ticket system may deliver the same notice twice. Use its ticket number to find the work already under way. First notice. DEMO-17 arrives. Start a session and store its session ID with the ticket. Repeat. The same notice arrives again. Look up DEMO-17 and use the saved session. Correction. A comment changes the date. Pass the correction into the same session and link its result to the ticket.
